confirmation.applies_to: every evaluated candidate with exceeds_heldout_both (held-out top-10 Jaccard AND Spearman below the original's held-out seed-pair minimum), in both physical status groups
confirmation.reported_as: confirmed_lime_success = lime_success AND confirmation_passed; lime_success (success criterion D8) is unchanged and is reported alongside
confirmation.rule: the candidate and its original are explained under the four confirmation seeds; the same combined rule is applied against the original's band on those seeds (6 pairs); confirmation_passed if both measures are below the band minimum again

role_note: pilot on the 10 Step 6 v2 flows and the current RF/XGBoost validation models; not the final experimental design (larger fixed per-category sample, nested-CV models, MLP); never pooled with final results; its outcome does not change success criteria, thresholds or the final sample-selection rule
scope: definitive only for the enumerated physical_v1 lattice, not for every possible network modification
success_rule: still attack (P >= 0.5) AND passes the enforced policy AND held-out top-10 Jaccard AND Spearman both below the sample's held-out seed-pair minimum AND (under physical_v1) physical status consistent_with_checked_rules
